# Building audit (generated by tools/building_audit.py)

16 outdoor city/town maps, 116 buildings (indoor map groups behind a city warp).

Columns: entry map; layout reuse (number of maps sharing the entry layout; 1 = unique); persistent state changed (flag/var/item/mon, temp and scratch state excluded); other effects (hide-flag toggles, trainer battles).

## Common state (set by 4+ buildings, excluded below)

FLAG_NURSE_MENTIONS_GOLD_CARD, FLAG_NURSE_UNION_ROOM_REMINDER, FLAG_POKERUS_EXPLAINED, OW_FLAG_MOVE_UNION_ROOM_CHECK, VAR_CABLE_CLUB_STATE, VAR_CABLE_CLUB_TUTORIAL_STATE, VAR_PETALBURG_GYM_STATE, VAR_SCOTT_STATE
